**Finding submitted: deviation (T4C), preferred level.**

- **What the document says:** § 11.1 commits Corio to an initial five-year term with automatic one-year renewals; § 11.2 permits termination only for uncured material breach or insolvency. Searches for convenience/without-cause exits, termination fees and refunds turned up nothing else (the only refund rights are acceptance-test failure, warranty failure and IP-indemnity, and there is no Order Form structure).
- **Why it fails:** no Customer convenience right at all in a multi-year term — short of both preferred and fallback.
- **Cure:** one inserted § 11.2A giving Corio convenience termination on 30 days' notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, and confirming Commerce One has no mid-term convenience exit; fallback (60–90 days plus a three-month fee cap) offered in the comment.
- **Not double-flagged:** the § 11.1 non-renewal right is natural-term non-renewal (RENEWAL), not a Vendor mid-term convenience exit.
